final_resume.summary: B.Tech Information Technology graduate (2023) seeking a Software Development Engineer role. Built production REST services and e-commerce backends using Java and Spring Boot, with strong problem-solving ability in data structures and algorithms. Demonstrated ownership across full-stack implementation, testing, and deployment.

projects.name: ShopEase - E-commerce Store
projects.description: Designed and deployed a full-stack e-commerce backend using Spring Boot and MySQL with React storefront on AWS EC2, integrating S3 for product images. Implemented cart, checkout, and order history features with RESTful APIs.

bullets: Built 6 REST endpoints in Spring Boot for the order-returns module backed by MySQL, enabling seamless return processing.
Wrote JUnit tests for the returns service, raising module test coverage from 45% to 70%.
Resolved 12 production bugs reported by the support team, ensuring system stability and reliability.

profile_improvement_tips: Build a project or contribute to open-source that explicitly demonstrates distributed systems concepts (e.g., microservices, message queues, eventual consistency).
Study and practise object-oriented design principles (SOLID, design patterns) and document them in a portfolio project or GitHub README.
Gain hands-on experience with system design through LeetCode System Design problems or a scalable backend project; mention trade-offs and architectural decisions in your resume.
final_resume.growth_note: You are a strong fresher with solid backend fundamentals, but the JD emphasizes distributed systems and object-oriented design—areas not yet evident in your profile. Gaining explicit experience in these will significantly strengthen your candidacy.
